audience: small businesses that manage clients, invoices and stock in STEL Order

useCases.title: Find unpaid invoice receipts that are due
useCases.text: List unpaid invoice receipts with a payment term date up to a chosen day, to see what is due.

useCases.title: Review sales orders of a period
useCases.text: List sales orders by date range, client or state, then read one client with its rate and payment settings.

useCases.title: Check stock movements in a warehouse
useCases.text: List the warehouses, then list the stock movements with the real stock before and after each movement.

useCases.title: Add a client and a contact
useCases.text: Create a client with its legal name, then create a contact linked to that client. Both calls add records to the account.

useCases.title: Find a product by reference
useCases.text: List products by reference or name, then read one product with its prices, tax and stock settings.
